svg.title: Milestones: dated checkpoints inside an epic or an initiative — SoftTrack web design mockup (#277)
svg.desc: An epic has one date, its target, and the things that must be true along the way are in a document. A milestone has a name and a date on an epic or an initiative, tickets can be given to it, one with no tickets is ticked off by hand, and the roadmap, the calendar and the burnup mark it.
svg.text: Milestones: dated checkpoints inside an epic or an initiative
· the dates along the way, on the bar
Things that must be true along the way

g.text: an epic’s page, signed in as Lena
5 of 7 tickets done · the date passed with 2 open
No tickets: ticked off by hand
The milestones offered are its epic’s. The board and list filter by
A milestone is a week away

milestone with no tickets is ticked off by hand, passing the date with work open marks it at risk in words, the roadmap, the calendar and the burnup mark each milestone, and the

g.text: An epic had one date, its target.
Now the bar has markers along it.
Passing the date with work open
marks it at risk, in words.
A milestone with no tickets is a date

A milestone’s progress is its tickets done against its tickets.
The roadmap draws milestones as markers on the epic’s bar. The
calendar shows them among the tickets due.
